# Vanyshr design system

> Design system for Vanyshr, generated for coding agents from its agent-facing bible.
> The bible is the source of truth; tokens.json below is a machine-readable subset of it.
> Stack: chrome → Konsta UI (React) · content → shadcn + Radix · viz → Recharts · icons → Lucide.

Generated 2026-09-17 — 97 tokens (amended 2026-09-17: +5 — primary/status badge borders, danger hover; dark chrome ladder rebased to neutral grey #242424 / #343434 / #444444 / #545454, count unchanged).

## Docs

- [Design bible](./DESIGN.md): full agent-facing spec — principles, tokens, states, component-library ownership map, anti-patterns.
- [Tokens (DTCG)](./tokens.json): tokens in W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. `:root` (dark, the app default) values only.
- [Component catalog](./COMPONENTS.md): adopted primitives with their owning library.

## Notes

- This file and tokens.json are mirrors of the bible. Do not hand-edit; regenerate from the bible via spec from Igor instead.
- Only tokens the bible declares inside a fenced ```css block are included.
- Light-mode overrides live in tokens.css under `.light` (same token names) and are not duplicated here.
- If a value disagrees between the bible and the project's own token file, the token file wins per the bible's own rule — treat tokens.json as a convenience mirror, not a second source of truth.
- Library theme variables (Konsta `--k-*`, shadcn theme vars) are derived from these tokens by the hand-maintained token bridge (DESIGN.md §12.4). Never set them by hand.
